kind: HOBL workload-recipe adapter, not full lab orchestration

comparability.original: Platform-specific upstream recipes; raw Windows/Mac differences are NOT OS-only.
comparability.aligned: Same Windows solution recipe AND schema prep on both OSes; hardware, tools and diagnostics still require attribution.

adaptations: Private pinned SDKs/runtimes and child-only environment instead of machine installation.
Owned-source Git operations use command-scoped core.longpaths=true; no global Git or Windows registry change.

A new owned workspace NuGet.Config replaces only inherited packageSourceMapping with v9.4.2's mappings. Audit, disabled-source, fallback, signer and signature-validation policy are retained; mapping replacement is a declared routing-policy adaptation.
Original Mac installs/verifies/shuts down its private SDK at source/.dotnet, the actual pinned tools.sh bootstrap root; solution profiles use run/dotnet.
Twenty seconds of the original total budget are reserved for bounded owned-SDK shutdown even after workload time expires.
Adapter scripts/helpers/manifest are snapshotted before setup. Actual compiler invocation count is unavailable; stdout command-line mentions are separately labeled.
No HOBL RPC/orchestrator, password helper, plugins, lab normalization or phase event provider.
Schema regeneration is untimed upstream prep on both original platforms; owned source diff is retained.
Default timed commands are recipe-exact. Opt-in diagnostic binlogs append /bl and are not directly comparable to uninstrumented runs.
macOS timed invocation uses upstream /usr/bin/time -p -o; Windows uses a monotonic wall stopwatch around the child command.
No machine/profile/Rosetta installation; existing Xcode, Node/npm and (original Mac) Python/Rosetta are prerequisites.
